description: Ministry of Women and Child Affairs - Regulation made to inform that the number of Adoption  Orders  shall be 100 for the Calendar Year 2017
reasoning: This gazette contains a regulation made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs under the Adoption of Children Ordinance, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. It establishes a statutory limit on adoption orders for a specific year, making it a regulatory framework matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
